description: This file implements push notification handling in the Mattermost server, including sending notifications, managing sessions, building messages, and interacting with push proxy services.

classes.name: PushNotificationsHub
classes.description: Manages push notification dispatching, including queuing, worker goroutines, and stopping mechanisms.

classes.name: PushNotification
classes.description: Represents a push notification with all relevant data such as type, user, channel, post, and mention flags.

methods.name: sendPushNotificationSync
methods.description: Builds and sends a push notification synchronously for a specific post and user.

methods.name: sendPushNotificationToAllSessions
methods.description: Sends a push notification to all active sessions of a user, with plugin hook support.

methods.name: sendPushNotification
methods.description: Queues a push notification to be sent for a specific post and user.

methods.name: getPushNotificationMessage
methods.description: Generates the message content for a push notification based on various parameters.

methods.name: getUserBadgeCount
methods.description: Retrieves the badge count for a user, including unread counts and mentions if CRT is enabled.

methods.name: clearPushNotificationSync
methods.description: Synchronously clears push notifications for a user in a specific channel/thread.

methods.name: clearPushNotification
methods.description: Queues a clear push notification for a user.

methods.name: updateMobileAppBadgeSync
methods.description: Synchronously updates the badge count on the mobile app for a user.

methods.name: UpdateMobileAppBadge
methods.description: Queues an update for the mobile app badge count.

methods.name: createPushNotificationsHub
methods.description: Initializes the push notifications hub with channels and worker goroutines.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Main loop for processing queued notifications and dispatching them.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Stops the notification processing, draining channels and waiting for goroutines.

methods.name: rawSendToPushProxy
methods.description: Sends a push notification to the external push proxy service.

methods.name: sendToPushProxy
methods.description: Handles sending a push notification to the proxy and processes the response.

methods.name: SendAckToPushProxy
methods.description: Sends an acknowledgment for received notifications to the push proxy.
